verdict_reason: Solid coverage of the two distinct 400 shapes and the traceId extension, but one test's only assertion sits behind a null guard that is always taken, so it passes without asserting anything.

todos.issue: No case covers a malformed JSON request body: HttpMessageNotReadableException extends RuntimeException, so GlobalExceptionHandler's @ExceptionHandler(RuntimeException.class) catch-all swallows it and returns 500 internal-error instead of a 400 bad-request problem - this missing case is exactly why that Critical shipped green
todos.fix: Add malformedJsonBody_returns400BadRequestProblem: build a MockMvc standaloneSetup with a stub controller taking @RequestBody, POST content("{not json") with APPLICATION_JSON, and assert status 400, content type application/problem+json, $.type = https://api.cdp.defra.cloud/problems/bad-request and no $.errors key (the Problem, not ValidationProblem, branch) - it must fail until an @ExceptionHandler(HttpMessageNotReadableException.class) is added

todos.issue: traceId_isOmittedWhenAbsentFromMdc guards its only assertion behind 'if (properties != null)'; with no MDC trace id and no errors map the handler never calls setProperty, so ProblemDetail.getProperties() is null and the test executes zero assertions while still passing green.
todos.fix: Drop the conditional and assert deterministically, e.g. assertThat(response.getBody().getProperties()).isNull(); (or isNullOrEmpty()), so the test actually pins the omit-traceId contract.

todos.issue: handleTypeMismatch is the only one of the five handler methods in GlobalExceptionHandler with no unit test here; OperatorListIT.listWithANonNumericPageReturns400BadRequestProblem pins status/type/absent-errors but nothing pins the detail string "Invalid value for parameter '<name>'" that embeds ex.getName().
todos.fix: Add a test calling exceptionHandler.handleTypeMismatch(new MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException("abc", Integer.class, "page", methodParameter, cause)) and assert the 400 bad-request type, the detail naming 'page', and doesNotContainKey("errors").

todos.issue: The validationException helper builds its MethodParameter from getDeclaredMethod("setUp"), coupling all four validation tests to the name of an unrelated @BeforeEach lifecycle method; renaming setUp makes them fail with 'Failed to build MethodArgumentNotValidException', which points nowhere near the real cause.
todos.fix: Reflect on a dedicated private placeholder (e.g. 'private void validationTarget(Object body) {}') declared next to the helper, so the reflected name exists only to serve the helper.

todos.issue: None of the seven tests carry the // Given / // When / // Then blocks the Java unit-testing guide states all tests use, and the names use an outcome-first subject (validationError_, badRequest_, notFound_) rather than the documented {method}_{shouldDoWhat} form used across the sibling repos (handleValidationException_shouldReturnBadRequestWithFieldErrors).
todos.fix: Rename to handleValidationException_shouldReturn400WithCamelCaseErrorsMap etc. and add the Given/When/Then comment blocks.
